description:
Change an existing DEFECT the way the SimplifyQA defect form does, then READ IT BACK and report each change. Pass `defectId` (id, code like DE-61, or exact name) and only what to change:
- `storyId` — the form's USER STORY field (story id or key, e.g. US-25; "none" clears it). This is NOT a Linkages row.
- `testCases` — the form's TEST CASE field: test cases to ADD, each "TC-41" or with its version "TC-41:v1.0" (no version = the test case's current one, and the answer says which). The defect then shows in each test case's linked defects — checked after saving. `removeTestCases` takes some out; `clearTestCases:true` empties the field.
- `state`, `priority`, `severity` (the project's own values; an unknown one is refused with the valid ones listed), `assignee` (email, name, user id or "me") or `unassign:true`, `releaseId` / `sprintId` (id, code or name; "none" clears), `name`, `description`.
- `environment`, `executionType` (alias `type`), `featureId`, `plannedStartDate`, `plannedEndDate` — the rest of the form ("none" clears one). Environment / Type are checked against the project's own list (or the form's: Development / QA / UAT, Manual / Automation).
- `linkages` — LINKAGES saved from the defect's side: [{ destType, destId, linkType }].
- `attachments` — files to attach to the defect ([{ filePath }]).
Needs the add_defect privilege.

assignee.description: Email, name, numeric user id or "me".

attachments.description: ATTACHMENTS: files to attach to the defect (max 20 MB each). To remove or download one later: attachment_delete / attachment_download with entityType "defect".

base64.description: File content as base64 when there is no local path. Requires fileName.

contentType.description: MIME type; inferred from the extension when omitted.

fileName.description: Name to store it under (default: the file's own name).

filePath.description: Absolute path of the file (read on this machine).

clearTestCases.description: true = empty the TEST CASE field.

defectId.description: Defect id, code (DE-61) or exact name.

environment.description: ENVIRONMENT: one of the project's own list, or the form's (Development, QA, UAT). An unknown value is refused with the valid ones.

executionType.description: TYPE (the form's Execution Type): Manual or Automation (or the project's own list).

featureId.description: FEATURE: a feature of this project — id, business key (FT-248) or exact name.

linkages.description: LINKAGES, saved from the DEFECT's side (the form's Linkages section). A link that already exists is left as it is.

destId.description: Its id or business key (US-25, DE-9, FT-248, TA-4).

destType.description: What the defect is linked TO.

linkType.description: The link type as the Linkages dropdown shows it ("Clones", "Relates to", …). An unknown one is refused with the available ones.

plannedEndDate.description: PLANNED END DATE, YYYY-MM-DD, on or after the start.

releaseId.description: Release: id, code (RE-44) or exact name; "none" clears it (and the sprint).

removeTestCases.description: Test cases to take out of the TEST CASE field.

sprintId.description: Sprint: id, code (SP-1) or exact name; it must belong to the defect's release. "none" clears it.

storyId.description: USER STORY field: story id or key (US-25); "none" clears it.

testCases.description: TEST CASE field — test cases to add: "TC-41" or "TC-41:v1.0".

type.description: Same as executionType — the form's TYPE field.

name: defect_update
title: Update a defect (state, assignee, environment, type, feature, dates, linkages, attachments, …)
